messages:
Maria: quick heads-up 10m sync tomorrow for the demo rehearsal. need signoff on run-of-show, fallback steps, and HubSpot field mapping. pls read before greenroom. @here

Maria: proposed run-of-show (compact):
- 0:00 welcome + agenda (Maria)
- 2:00 why benchmarks matter: cost vs latency tradeoffs (Josh)
- 7:30 live demo: hosted -> dedicated failover & model switch (Ezra)
- 16:00 audience Q&A + CTA form (Priya)
- 22:00 wrap

Ezra: demo notes 1: we'll simulate a latency spike by throttling network to the hosted endpoint and trigger the auto-fallback. primary route = demo-hosted (redwood/v1-small). fallback route = demo-dedicated (redwood/v1-medium-quant). We'll show brief logs so folks see the routing change.

Josh: add a slide explaining why we might intentionally choose a quantized variant (cost/throughput) and call out subtle output differences. keep it one bullet and a link to the eval notebook.

Priya: CTA form fields: hs_webinar_source = "mar_webinar_2026", hs_inferred_interest = "hosting_or_dedicated", hidden field model_demo_variant. Also want utm_campaign param campaign=webinar_mar26 on all panelist links. I'll create the HubSpot workflow to tag leads and add to list.

Maria: ops ask 1: can we get the exact switch commands for rehearsal and reset? need to paste into the runbook so stage manager can flip quickly.

Ezra: paste below (demo VM uses short-lived token injected into $DEMO_TOKEN):

```
# switch to fallback dedicated pool
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"demo-route","target":"redwood/v1-medium-quant","reason":"latency_fallback"}'
```

Ezra: and to reset back to primary:
```
# reset to primary
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.dev/v1/admin/switch-route \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"route":"demo-route","target":"redwood/v1-small","reason":"post_demo_reset"}'
```

Maria: perfect. Ops will run the pre-warm 8m prior. DeployBot, schedule prewarm?

DeployBot: Scheduled: prewarm for demo-dedicated at 2026-03-24T09:22:00Z (initiated by Ezra).

Josh: note on fidelity 1: quantized medium will slightly change tokenization for edge cases. we'll avoid the long-form creative example; use a short Q&A prompt. add an on-screen caption that diffs may exist.

Priya: live chat triage: who owns pricing vs SLA questions? I can answer hosted pricing questions, Maria can handle Dedicated commitments and SLOs. Also add a canned reply for "how to get Dedicated" with the contact form link.

Maria: I'll own chat triage. Priya, please drop the one-pagers in the rehearsal folder.

Priya: uploaded: https://redwood.share/rehearsal/mar_demo_assets (one-pagers + slide deck updates). added hidden HubSpot field and workflow in test.

Ezra: rehearsal checklist for greenroom:
- Confirm greenroom VPN & mic (all)
- Prewarm dedicated pool 8m before start (ops)
- Demo token scoped to route-change only (security)
- Start captions + recording at :56 (recording owner: Priya)
- Add slide 4 with "benchmark caveats" (Josh)

Maria: final asks: be in greenroom 9:10 PT, captions on, start recording 9:25 PT, rehearsal at 9:30 PT. I'll paste the runbook into the rehearsal doc. See you there. :rocket:
